description: One Kamchatka tour in depth: program, what is included, what to bring, safety notes. A company or guide name returns a tour list and their page instead. To list or search tours use get_tours. Always use it for questions about a specific tour (program, meeting point, pickup, what to bring); never invent these details. A generic or partial company name also lists other companies' tours with those words. If only some words matched, the reply says so: do not call those tours a match.

name.description: Tour title, numeric ID, a keyword, or the name of a company or guide selling tours (the reply then lists tours and their page, not one tour).
